title: The Molten Cistern
text: A cistern brims with metal that never cooled, glowing like a sunset beneath a wrinkled skin. Ingots float on top like ice on a pond, bobbing gently. The heat makes your eyes water from ten paces away.

options.label: Fish out ingots with a pole, keeping well back from the heat.

outcomes.text: You land a good haul, still smoking.
The pole catches fire, then a sleeve, then the next sleeve.

options.label: The quickest reaches for the best ingot, fast enough to beat the heat.

outcomes.text: They snatch a bar of star iron and pull back before the heat can bite.
They have it, and then the heat has them.

options.label: Leave the cistern be; no iron is worth that fire.

outcomes.text: It bubbles at you as you turn, and one bubble bursts across the Leader's sleeve.

options.label: The one in plate wades in for an ingot, trusting their steel to hold.

outcomes.text: The plate glows red but holds. It comes out with an ingot in its fist.
The plate holds. The one inside it is another matter.
